CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255), 
	username VARCHAR(120), 
	password_hash VARCHAR(255), 
	role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	access_level VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	company_name VARCHAR(255), 
	phone VARCHAR(60), 
	phone_extension VARCHAR(20), 
	shipping_name VARCHAR(255), 
	shipping_address TEXT, 
	billing_address TEXT, 
	shipping_same_as_billing BOOLEAN, 
	assigned_promo_code VARCHAR(40), 
	assigned_discount_percent INTEGER, 
	approval_status VARCHAR(20), 
	approval_decided_at DATETIME, 
	approval_decided_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (email), 
	UNIQUE (username)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_display_name_lower ON users (lower(display_name))

CREATE TABLE quotes (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quote_number VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	customer_name VARCHAR(255), 
	customer_address TEXT, 
	customer_contact TEXT, 
	customer_reference VARCHAR(255), 
	comments TEXT, 
	special_instructions TEXT, 
	order_form_snapshot JSON, 
	pricing_version VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	discount NUMERIC(8, 4), 
	model_code VARCHAR(120), 
	cylinder_inputs_snapshot JSON, 
	price_breakdown_snapshot JSON, 
	created_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	edited_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	edited_at DATETIME, 
	emailed_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	emailed_at DATETIME, 
	approved_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	approved_at DATETIME, 
	assigned_employee_user_id INTEGER, 
	assigned_at DATETIME, 
	customer_update_pending BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (quote_number)
)

CREATE TABLE quote_number_sequences (
	year INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	next_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (year)
)

CREATE TABLE quote_line_items (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quote_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reference_part_number VARCHAR(120), 
	description VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(12, 4) NOT NULL, 
	unit_price NUMERIC(12, 4) NOT NULL, 
	extended_price NUMERIC(12, 4) NOT NULL, 
	internal_note TEXT, 
	show_on_customer_quote BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quote_id) REFERENCES quotes (id)
)

CREATE TABLE quote_documents (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quote_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	file_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quote_id) REFERENCES quotes (id)
)

CREATE TABLE approval_submissions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quote_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	request_payload JSON, 
	request_sent_at DATETIME, 
	response_status_code INTEGER, 
	response_body TEXT, 
	success BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	created_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quote_id) REFERENCES quotes (id), 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)

CREATE TABLE email_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quote_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recipients JSON NOT NULL, 
	subject VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	sent_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	sent_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	document_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quote_id) REFERENCES quotes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES quote_documents (id)
)

CREATE TABLE orders (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quote_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quote_number VARCHAR(60), 
	order_form_snapshot JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (quote_id)
)

CREATE TABLE catalog_parts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	part_number VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	family_code VARCHAR(40), 
	category VARCHAR(80), 
	unit_cost NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	sell_price NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	sell_price_source VARCHAR(255), 
	inventory_cost_values TEXT, 
	shipvia_sell_values TEXT, 
	acc_sell_values TEXT, 
	all_descriptions TEXT, 
	source_locations TEXT, 
	vendors TEXT, 
	review_needed VARCHAR(20), 
	review_reason TEXT, 
	active VARCHAR(20), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (part_number)
)

CREATE TABLE part_families (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	family_code VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	material VARCHAR(80), 
	part_type VARCHAR(80), 
	image_path VARCHAR(255), 
	description_template TEXT, 
	size_rule VARCHAR(255), 
	auto_description_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (family_code)
)

CREATE TABLE base_assembly_prices (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pricing_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	series VARCHAR(120), 
	bore VARCHAR(60), 
	rod VARCHAR(60), 
	mount_group TEXT, 
	base_price NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	base_price_raw TEXT, 
	cushion_base NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	cushion_base_raw TEXT, 
	per_unit_price NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	per_unit_price_raw TEXT, 
	cushion_per_end NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	cushion_per_end_raw TEXT, 
	rod_thread_std VARCHAR(120), 
	rod_thread_oversize VARCHAR(120), 
	unit VARCHAR(30), 
	source_sheet VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	source_row INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_import_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (source_import_index)
)

CREATE TABLE common_modification_prices (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	series VARCHAR(120), 
	bore VARCHAR(60), 
	rod VARCHAR(60), 
	option_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	base_price NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	base_price_raw TEXT, 
	per_unit_price NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	per_unit_price_raw TEXT, 
	unit VARCHAR(30), 
	source_sheet VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	source_row INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_import_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (source_import_index)
)

CREATE TABLE ph_va_prices (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pricing_group VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	series VARCHAR(120), 
	bore VARCHAR(60), 
	rod VARCHAR(60), 
	option_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	base_price NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	base_price_raw TEXT, 
	per_unit_price NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	per_unit_price_raw TEXT, 
	unit VARCHAR(30), 
	source_sheet VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	source_row INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_import_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (source_import_index)
)

CREATE TABLE price_change_log (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	table_name VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	row_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	field_name VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	record_label VARCHAR(255), 
	record_description TEXT, 
	old_value NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	new_value NUMERIC(14, 4), 
	old_text TEXT, 
	new_text TEXT, 
	change_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	batch_id VARCHAR(40), 
	batch_summary VARCHAR(255), 
	changed_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	changed_by_name VARCHAR(120), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE customers (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	address TEXT, 
	city_state_zip VARCHAR(255), 
	phone VARCHAR(255), 
	email VARCHAR(255), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

UPDATE users
            SET approval_status = 'pending'
            WHERE is_active = 0
              AND (approval_status IS NULL OR approval_status = 'approved')

SELECT catalog_parts.id AS catalog_parts_id, catalog_parts.part_number AS catalog_parts_part_number, catalog_parts.description AS catalog_parts_description, catalog_parts.family_code AS catalog_parts_family_code, catalog_parts.category AS catalog_parts_category, catalog_parts.unit_cost AS catalog_parts_unit_cost, catalog_parts.sell_price AS catalog_parts_sell_price, catalog_parts.sell_price_source AS catalog_parts_sell_price_source, catalog_parts.inventory_cost_values AS catalog_parts_inventory_cost_values, catalog_parts.shipvia_sell_values AS catalog_parts_shipvia_sell_values, catalog_parts.acc_sell_values AS catalog_parts_acc_sell_values, catalog_parts.all_descriptions AS catalog_parts_all_descriptions, catalog_parts.source_locations AS catalog_parts_source_locations, catalog_parts.vendors AS catalog_parts_vendors, catalog_parts.review_needed AS catalog_parts_review_needed, catalog_parts.review_reason AS catalog_parts_review_reason, catalog_parts.active AS catalog_parts_active 
FROM catalog_parts

SELECT users.id, users.display_name, users.email, users.username, users.password_hash, users.role, users.access_level, users.company_name, users.phone, users.phone_extension, users.shipping_name, users.shipping_address, users.billing_address, users.shipping_same_as_billing, users.assigned_promo_code, users.assigned_discount_percent, users.approval_status, users.approval_decided_at, users.approval_decided_by_user_id, users.is_active, users.created_at 
FROM users 
WHERE users.role = ? AND users.is_active IS 1 AND (lower(users.username) = ? OR lower(users.email) = ?)

SELECT users.id AS users_id, users.display_name AS users_display_name, users.email AS users_email, users.username AS users_username, users.password_hash AS users_password_hash, users.role AS users_role, users.access_level AS users_access_level, users.company_name AS users_company_name, users.phone AS users_phone, users.phone_extension AS users_phone_extension, users.shipping_name AS users_shipping_name, users.shipping_address AS users_shipping_address, users.billing_address AS users_billing_address, users.shipping_same_as_billing AS users_shipping_same_as_billing, users.assigned_promo_code AS users_assigned_promo_code, users.assigned_discount_percent AS users_assigned_discount_percent, users.approval_status AS users_approval_status, users.approval_decided_at AS users_approval_decided_at, users.approval_decided_by_user_id AS users_approval_decided_by_user_id, users.is_active AS users_is_active, users.created_at AS users_created_at 
FROM users 
WHERE users.id = ?

SELECT catalog_parts.id AS catalog_parts_id, catalog_parts.part_number AS catalog_parts_part_number, catalog_parts.description AS catalog_parts_description, catalog_parts.family_code AS catalog_parts_family_code, catalog_parts.category AS catalog_parts_category, catalog_parts.unit_cost AS catalog_parts_unit_cost, catalog_parts.sell_price AS catalog_parts_sell_price, catalog_parts.sell_price_source AS catalog_parts_sell_price_source, catalog_parts.inventory_cost_values AS catalog_parts_inventory_cost_values, catalog_parts.shipvia_sell_values AS catalog_parts_shipvia_sell_values, catalog_parts.acc_sell_values AS catalog_parts_acc_sell_values, catalog_parts.all_descriptions AS catalog_parts_all_descriptions, catalog_parts.source_locations AS catalog_parts_source_locations, catalog_parts.vendors AS catalog_parts_vendors, catalog_parts.review_needed AS catalog_parts_review_needed, catalog_parts.review_reason AS catalog_parts_review_reason, catalog_parts.active AS catalog_parts_active 
FROM catalog_parts

UPDATE catalog_parts SET sell_price=? WHERE catalog_parts.id = ?
